title: Beechmount House, Garryhankard, Innishannon, Cork, T12WE16
seoTitle: Beechmount House, Garryhankard, Innishannon, Cork, T12WE16
description:
Beechmount House, Innishannon, Co. Cork, presents a rare opportunity to acquire an exceptional period residence set within approximately 24 acres of magnificent grounds. Dating back originally to 1830, this distinguished home combines the elegance and character of a bygone era with the comfort and presentation expected of a modern luxury property.

Approached through an electronic gated entrance and along a sweeping private driveway, the sense of arrival is immediate. From the moment you enter the grounds, Beechmount House exudes a feeling of privacy, prestige and timeless quality. The beautifully maintained residence extends to over 5,000 sq ft and is presented in pristine condition throughout.

Inside, the house retains a wealth of original period features, including beautiful high ceilings, wall panelling, ornate cornicing and elegant ceiling roses. These details provide a wonderful sense of scale and grandeur, while the overall presentation ensures the property is ready for immediate occupation. A particularly attractive feature is the Hamptons-designed conservatory, built in 2005, which provides a stylish and light-filled space overlooking the surrounding grounds and offers an ideal setting for relaxation and entertaining.

The extensive acreage further enhances the appeal of Beechmount House. With ample space for equestrian interests, farming or simply enjoying the privacy and freedom of a substantial country estate, the property offers exceptional versatility. The land provides a rare opportunity to embrace a rural lifestyle while remaining within easy reach of Cork City and west Cork. There is also a spectacular walled in orchard garden growing eating apples.

The location is a further significant attraction. Cork City is approximately a 25-minute drive away, while the picturesque harbour town of Kinsale is less than 20 minutes from the property. This places Beechmount House within convenient reach of excellent restaurants, sailing, coastal walks and a wide range of amenities, while preserving the peace and tranquillity of its countryside setting.

Beechmount House is a truly special property, a magnificent historic home, beautifully maintained, set in an outstanding landscape and offering an enviable combination of elegance, space and lifestyle. For those seeking a substantial country residence with equestrian or agricultural potential, yet close to Cork and Kinsale, this exceptional property represents a rare opportunity
